profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at UTC Aerospace Systems
profile.geoLocationName: St. Croix County, Wisconsin, United States
profile.summary: Specialties: embedded systems, C, assembly language,  DOORS, Matlab Stateflow and Simulink, budgeting,  continuous improvement,  contracts,  control, documentation,  drivers,  c++,  case tools,  computer hardware,  management, html,  hvac, intel, iso 9000,  java, lan, leadership, logic, mentoring,  microprocessors, modems, negotiation, pc, process engineering, programming,  project management, PVCS, real time,  RTOS,  software architecture, software development, software documentation,  specifications, teamwork,  unix,  visual basic,  x86

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: All phases of software development, requirements, design and implementation according to DO-178B/ DO-178C standards, using C and assembly language.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Leading two teams in software development for embedded aircraft sensors, including Software Requirements Specification (SRS), code design, implementation in C, reviews of each and interface with external verification vendor. Freescale MC9S12 family processors used. Led Continuous Improvement (CI) events which generated C Coding and Software Design Standards; participated in two other CI events which generated a Requirements Standard and reviewed application of C Coding Standard.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Led team in all phases of software development for embedded automobile HVAC control, including SRS, code design and implementation in C, uCOSII RTOS and reviews of each. Freescale MC9S12 family processors used. Contributions made to Development Process Improvement.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description: Performed contract services for Andar clients, including embedded system programming on Hitachi H8, TI MSP430 and Atmel ATMega128 micros, PC's and embedded PC's in assembly language, C and C++, PC motherboard development, Phoenix Technologies Ltd. and AWARD BIOS development, I2C interface, project management and software documentation.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Embedded system development in assembly and C on a Cygnal 8051 derivative using Keil IDE. Visual C++ GUI development. Application includes serial communications, A/D and inertial system control from accelerometer input.

positions.title: Director of Advanced Engineering
positions.description: Provided team leadership to a staff of 24 involved in PC motherboard, BIOS and driver development. Our team designed the motherboard used in the system named Workstation of the Year in 1997 by PC Magazine. Contract development performed for embedded PC applications. Led the team in establishing ISO 9000 procedures for all departmental disciplines. Member of corporate Training Advisory Council.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed PC BIOS's using Phoenix Technologies code base. Wrote diagnostic and user utilities in X86 assembler, C and C++. Supervised two other BIOS engineers

positions.title: Design Engineer
positions.description: Designed and coded a PCMCIA interface and ported existing drivers to it. Developed firmware in C and assembler for an embedded 80188 monitoring device. Used CASE tools for design development and documentation. Co-authored a feasibility study for the development of a hand-held PC. Schematic entry and rough layout of a redesign effort using Mentor Graphics tools. Co-authored Software Development Guidelines. Converted a large existing routine to a state machine. All work done in a teamwork environment with an emphasis on Quality procedures, and completed on schedule.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Ported Texas Instruments Graphics Architecture package to PC Tech designed TMS 340 color and monochrome boards.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed firmware for TI 34010 and 34020 graphic processor based boards in C and assembler. Wrote code for 340x0 processors and 80x86 based MSDOS and UNIX machines. Wrote a UNIX device driver, two boot ROMs for 34010 based boards, one of which included a video BIOS interrupt 10 handler. Wrote diagnostic and production burnin code. Provided customer support for OEM customers and X server end users. Assisted in hardware debug of initial production run of a 34010 board for a time critical contract.

positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.description: New product and continued software development on TI 34010 based products in C and assembler. Code written for the 34010 and 80x86 based PCs. Responsible for all software development. Supervised one additional Software Engineer. Project management included spec approval, weekly updates to senior management, helping solve hardware problems when necessary, final signoff, negotiation and administration of outside contracts.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Project responsibility for development of a TI 34010 based graphics controller, and specific duties of software development on same. Software written in C and assembler for both the TI 34010 and 80x86 processors. Project leader interface with monitor vendor. All work done on schedule.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description: Sole responsibility for software development and continuation for data over voice modems. Worked with Intel 8051 and Motorola 68705 applied as controllers. Implemented a design on a Xilinx programmable array.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Sole responsibility for software development for an intelligent IBM 3270 compatible multiplexer. Defined and implemented system. Hardware debug of an intelligent video board, and software development for same. All work done with the Zilog Z80 in assembler.

positions.title: Development Engineer
positions.description: Software design and implementation of a LAN for Apple IIs, work done on a tight schedule. Other programs for the 6502, including applications on the Apple II. Hardware and software development of a software driven A/D converter, using the Z8.

positions.title: Development Engineer
positions.description: Sole responsibility for software design and implementation of a monitor device. Wrote a heating and cooling control routine for a residential control device. Designed the interface to a speech processor. Managed a small development. Used Intel 8049 and Synertek Z8 microprocessors.

positions.title: Engineer Assistant
positions.description: Design, debug, test and repair of digital and analog circuits for use on an atmospheric sounding rocket.
